val_unanswerable_vs_benchmark_unanswerab.note: All 8 validation unanswerable are also in the benchmark. This is by design: the benchmark was constructed to include all 42 derived unanswerable examples. Validation uses the same source examples.

holdout_vs_benchmark_unanswerable.note: All 22 holdout examples are also in the benchmark. Same design: the benchmark includes all 42 derived unanswerable. The holdout is a subset of the benchmark for additional diagnostic analysis.

document_level_overlap.note: All unanswerable examples (validation + holdout) are derived from the same 42-question document pool. Document-level overlap between validation and holdout is expected since they sample from the same source documents. H20 training examples span 17 different documents with zero overlap with derived dataset documents.

near_duplicate_check.note: No near-duplicate detection tooling available in current codebase

severity_assessment.val_benchmark_overlap: EXPECTED_BY_DESIGN — validation unanswerable are a subset of benchmark unanswerable
severity_assessment.holdout_benchmark_overlap: EXPECTED_BY_DESIGN — holdout is a diagnostic subset of benchmark unanswerable
